title: 中华民国总统府记者会：赖清德访非行程受阻，中国施压三国取消航线许可｜新闻特写20260422
executive_summary: The video discusses Lai Ching-te's visit to non-Chinese countries and the obstacles faced due to Chinese pressure, affecting flight routes.

key_facts: Lai Ching-te, the President of Taiwan, faced issues with his visit to non-Chinese countries.
Chinese pressure led to the cancellation of flight routes.
forward_implications: The incident may escalate tensions between Taiwan and China.
It could impact Taiwan's diplomatic relations with other countries.
